neighbours.label: ' without' (and purposive ' to') in practical product / how-to text: an item doing its job without failing (holds weight without breaking)
fire: This canvas tote carries a full load of books without ripping at the seams.
The shelf brackets support up to fifty pounds without bending.
You can peel garlic in seconds without using a knife at all.
These clamps grip the board firmly without leaving marks on the wood.
The stroller folds flat with one hand, without having to remove the seat.
The waterproof jacket keeps you dry in heavy rain without feeling stuffy.
Adjust the arm to bring the monitor up to eye level for comfortable viewing.
The ladder locks into place so you can work overhead without wobbling.
quiet: This canvas tote carries a full load of books and comes in four colours.
The shelf brackets support up to fifty pounds and come with screws.
You can peel garlic in seconds by shaking the cloves in a jar.
These clamps grip the board firmly and have soft rubber pads.
The stroller folds flat with one hand and fits in a small car trunk.
The waterproof jacket keeps you dry in heavy rain and packs into its pocket.
Adjust the arm until the monitor sits where you like it on the desk.
The ladder locks into place and has a tray for paint and tools.
